ResearchProjectDef.label: aesthetic module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial nose replacement. The module is functionally nearly identical to a standard aesthetic nose implant. However, a layer of synthetic skin allows it to be installed onto non-biological replacements.

ResearchProjectDef.label: airwire module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into an ear or any compatible artificial ear replacement. The module is equipped with a compact comms array that slightly increases the user's bandwidth.

ResearchProjectDef.label: alcohol synthesizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a liver or any compatible artificial liver replacement. The module is capable of synthesizing alcohol and releasing it into the body. It's able to suppress alcohol cravings, but properly curing an addiction is not possible with an implant such as this one.

ResearchProjectDef.label: analyzer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. This model features a small, portable multi-analyzer, which helps analyze and process large amounts of data. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

ResearchProjectDef.label: antigrain trap deployer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying antigrain warhead IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with an antigrain warhead in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: assault rifle module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified assault rifle that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: assembler subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in crafting-related tasks and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can save and display blueprints along with detailed information about various materials and components.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: atmofilter module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a lung or any compatible artificial lung replacement. The module greatly reduces the intake of toxins found in heavily polluted air by utilizing a series of advanced microfilters.

ResearchProjectDef.label: atompower module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module is capable of greatly enhancing its host's body by supplying it with additional energy produced by a miniature nuclear generator. It has to be regularly fueled with uranium in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: autopistol module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module includes a modified autopistol that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: biowelder module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any any compatible artificial heart replacement. The module frequently releases a small swarm of biowelder mechanites throughout the host's body, greatly increasing the rate at which their wounds heal.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botanist subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in plant-related tasks and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can quickly and accurately analyze plants in order to efficiently care for and get the most out of them.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: brawler lens combat module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into an eye or any compatible artificial eye replacement. The module is able to quickly analyze the user's surroundings and forward the data in a form of a simple interface. Its weak point detection, threat warning and impact point prediction features make it especially useful for those that specialize in melee combat.

ResearchProjectDef.label: brawler subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in melee combat. The subpersona can quickly and accurately predict oncoming attacks while also efficiently planning out offensive maneuvers.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: chain shotgun module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified chain shotgun that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: charge lance module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified charge lance that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: charge rifle module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified charge rifle that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: chef subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in cooking and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can quickly analyze a food item's temperature, consistency and accurately predict the taste with just a quick glance.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: chef module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. This model is equipped with a simple bioanalyzer and a variety of cooking utensils. It is also highly resistant to heat, which allows the user to safely make contact with hot surfaces and substances. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

ResearchProjectDef.label: chempower module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module is capable of greatly enhancing its host's body by supplying it with additional energy produced by a miniature chemfuel generator. It has to be regularly fueled with chemfuel in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: coagulator module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any any compatible artificial heart replacement. The module releases coagulating factors in response to blood loss, reducing bleeding rate significantly.

ResearchProjectDef.label: constructor subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in construction-related tasks and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can quickly analyze and measure different materials without the need for specialized tools.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: constructor module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. This model is equipped with a variety of retractable multi-purpose tools and measuring equipment that greatly speed up repair and construction efforts. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cooler module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a lung or any compatible artificial lung replacement. The module is able to remove excess heat from the body when it's in an uncomfortably or dangerously warm environment.

ResearchProjectDef.label: crafter module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. This model is equipped with a variety of retractable multi-purpose tools and measuring equipment, perfect for assembling delicate components or detailed pieces of art. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cryoprojector module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module is capable of producing immense amounts of a cryogenic microgas and trapping it in a bubble-like barrier it projects around its host, slowly freezing everything within its range. While the user is safe from being directly affected by the implant when it's active, it will harm both enemies and allies that do not possess sufficient protection.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cryoweave module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial limb or spine replacement. This particular model, upon detecting an attack on the user, sends out a directional burst of cryogenic micro-gas toward the attacker through the module's vent-like openings. Due to its limited effective range it is most potent in close-quarters combat, especially against assailants within melee range.

ResearchProjectDef.label: crypto turret gravdrone module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible spine replacement. The module consists of a drone-like turret platform suspended mid-air, powered entirely by a gravcore and a chip-like implant that keeps the floating construct anchored to its user. While no outside input of fuel or energy is necessary for it to function, it does require time to self-recharge and for that reason the user is tasked with deciding when to activate it. This specific gravdrone is equipped with an advanced cryptostinger turret which, while lightweight, consumes more energy than other models of similar size, which reduces the amount of time it can remain active.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deadlife burst module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module is capable of producing a cloud of deadlife dust around its user by releasing a concoction of volatile chemicals and dormant archites through vent-like openings. Syncing with other modules of the same model allows it to work with greater efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deadlife spewer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial lung replacement. The module produces and mixes specialized chemicals that can be sent through the airways and launched out of the mouth or nose. The resulting chemical reaction activates the dormant archites stored in the module and creates a wave of deadlife dust. Syncing with other modules of the same model allows it to work with greater efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: deadlife trap deployer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying deadlife IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with deadlife shells in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: detoxifier module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module is equipped with a series of nanofilters that are capable of removing toxins from the blood.

ResearchProjectDef.label: devourer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a jaw or any compatible jaw replacement. The module allows the mouth to be opened to a degree that would normally require the unhinging of one's jaw, allowing the user to consume food significantly faster. Highly flexible and stretchy synthetic skin prevents injuries or disfiguration that would result from such a maneuver.

ResearchProjectDef.label: disruptor flare module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial leg replacement. The module includes a disruptor flare dispenser which can be used similarly to a standard grenade belt or its contents can be launched directly from it with a swift leg motion. It is relatively small and well-hidden, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks. Needs to be reloaded with bioferrite after use.

ResearchProjectDef.label: doomsday rocket launcher module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for doomsday rocket launchers. After firing, what remains of the launcher is safely ejected and a replacement one can be loaded. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: drill module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. This model features a retractable drill which can act as both a useful tool and a deadly, albeit odd weapon. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EMP burst module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module is capable of producing an EMP blast around its user. While the host is shielded from the blast, any nearby allies or structures will be affected. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EMP grenade module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial leg replacement. The module includes an EMP grenade dispenser which can be used similarly to a standard grenade belt or its contents can be launched directly from it with a swift leg motion. It is relatively small and well-hidden, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EMP launcher module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified EMP launcher that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: EMP trap deployer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying EMP IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with EMP shells in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: echolocation module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into an ear or any compatible ear replacement. The module is capable of gathering data through an echolocation-like process and sending it directly to the brain. It is then received in a form of a subconscious understanding of the surrounding area, including objects outside of one's field of view.

ResearchProjectDef.label: elbow blade module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module is nearly identical to a standard elbow blade implant in terms of functionality.

ResearchProjectDef.label: explosive trap deployer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying explosive IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with high-explosive shells in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fertility adjuster module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a pelvis or any compatible artificial pelvis replacement. The module can affect an organism's reproductive system in a variety of ways. The host's fertility can be suppressed or enhanced depending on the settings that are adjustable via a quick and non-invasive medical procedure.

ResearchProjectDef.label: field module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module is equipped with a variety of miniaturized tools and an advanced bioanalyzer that greatly enhance a farmer’s speed and efficiency. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

ResearchProjectDef.label: firefoam trap deployer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying firefoam IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with firefoam shells in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: flashlight module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into an ear or any compatible ear replacement. The module acts as a compact and portable flashlight which makes sitting around in darkness slightly less upsetting.

ResearchProjectDef.label: frag grenade module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial leg replacement. The module includes a frag grenade dispenser which can be used similarly to a standard grenade belt or its contents can be launched directly from it with a swift leg motion. It is relatively small and well-hidden, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fuelmaker module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. The module refines excess nutrients along with normally unusable or indigestible biological material into chemfuel. The amount produced depends on the amount of food consumed by its host.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gastro-analyzer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial nose replacement. The module is equipped with a series of miniature sensors that function similarly to a standard issue gastro-analyzer implant, allowing the user to cook more effectively.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gastrosterilizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. The module is equipped with a broad-spectrum toxin filter and neutralization system, completely removing any risk of food poisoning.

ResearchProjectDef.label: go-juice synthesizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a liver or any compatible artificial liver replacement. The module is capable of synthesizing small doses of go-juice and releasing them into the body. It's able to suppress go-juice cravings, but properly curing an addiction is not possible with an implant such as this one.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gut worms immunizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat gut worms, granting complete immunity to their infections. It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hand talon module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module is nearly identical to a standard hand talon implant in terms of functionality.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heater module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a lung or any compatible artificial lung replacement. The module is able to produce heat and safely spread it throughout the body when it's in an uncomfortably or dangerously cold environment.

ResearchProjectDef.label: heavy SMG module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified heavy SMG that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hemofilter module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any compatible artificial heart replacement. The module is equipped with a variety of advanced filters that help break down and eliminate harmful elements from the host’s blood.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hemomaker module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. This implant model refines excess nutrients and typically indigestible biological material, repurposing it to produce extra blood using the host's cells. Once a sufficient amount has been produced, it can be packed into hemogen packs and ejected from the implant. The amount of hemogen produced depends on the amount of food consumed by its host. Sanguophages and other genetically modified humans that are incapable of naturally producing their own hemogen cannot make use of this implant.

ResearchProjectDef.label: high-explosive burst module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module is capable of producing a powerful explosion around its user by releasing a concoction of volatile chemicals through vent-like openings. While the host is shielded from the blast, any nearby allies or structures will be affected. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hover module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module utilizes gravcore technology in order to allow its user to gently hover above the ground, letting them traverse rough terrain with ease.

ResearchProjectDef.label: hunter drone deployer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for hunter packs. The core functions of the pack remains the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: immunoenhancer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a liver or kidney along with any compatible artificial replacement. The module boosts the user's resistance to diseases by releasing small swarms of viruskiller mechanites throughout the body.

ResearchProjectDef.label: incendiary burst module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module is capable of producing an incendiary explosion around its user by releasing a concoction of volatile chemicals through vent-like openings. While the host is shielded from the blast, any nearby allies or structures will be affected. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: incendiary launcher module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified incendiary launcher that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: incendiary trap deployer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module comes with a compact storage and launch system for deploying incendiary IED traps from a distance. The implant needs to be loaded with incendiary shells in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: jump pack module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module comes with a modified jump pack. It is compact enough to fully retract into the body and can be carried around with ease, though it has a lower charge capacity as a result. The module uses chemfuel in order to function and has to be reloaded after use.

ResearchProjectDef.label: knee spike module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial leg replacement. The module is nearly identical to a standard knee spike implant in terms of functionality.

ResearchProjectDef.label: LMG module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified LMG that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: leap module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial leg replacement. This particular model's compact mechanical muscles allow the user to jump great distances. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: low-shield deployer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for low-shield packs. The core functions of the pack remains the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: lung rot immunizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat lung rot, granting complete immunity to it. It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.

ResearchProjectDef.label: magprojector module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module is capable of projecting a bubble-like barrier for the purpose of containing and intensifying electromagnetic disturbances that it emits when active, creating an area that's extremely harmful to electronic equipment. While the user is safe from being directly affected by the module, it will damage any nearby machinery and implants that are vulnerable to EMP attacks, regardless of who they belong to.

ResearchProjectDef.label: magweave module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial limb or spine replacement. This particular model, upon detecting an attack on the user, sends out a directional electromagnetic pulse towards the attacker. Due to its limited effective range it is most potent in close-quarters combat, especially against assailants within melee range.

ResearchProjectDef.label: malaria immunizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat malaria along with neutralizing the parasite causing the condition, granting complete immunity to it. It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mechanalyzer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into an eye or any compatible artificial eye replacement. The module is able to pick up on a mech's faint psychic signal containing its self-diagnosis data. A simple interface highlights and describes damaged mechanoid components in real time.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mecharray module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into an arm, leg or any compatible artificial limb replacement. The module is equipped with a compact mechanoid control system and signal array that allows its host to control larger groups of mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mechlord subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in managing mechanoids and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can perform certain tasks and calculations necessary to command and maintain large mechanoid groups on its own, allowing the mechanitor to instead focus on ones not doable by a machine.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mechsensor module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a nose or any compatible artificial nose replacement. The module comes with advanced sensors that detect and analyze even the most subtle of changes in a mech gestator's assembler fluid which makes it significantly easier to adjust and calibrate a gestation or resurrection cycle for maximum efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: medic module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. This model is equipped with an advanced bioanalyzer, biowelder and a retractable self-sterilizing scalpel. A compact support system makes it easy and comfortable to carry around.

ResearchProjectDef.label: medprojector module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module is capable of projecting a bubble-like barrier for the purpose of containing the swarm of healing nanites and aerosolized glitterworld drugs that it releases when active. Anyone within its range will slowly have their non-permanent wounds and injuries healed. Needs to be loaded with glitterworld medicine in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mindreader module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into an eye or any compatible artificial eye replacement. The module is able to quickly analyze a person's facial expression, speech and body language. The collected data is then forwarded to the user via a simple, non-intrusive interface. It's currently the closest thing to contactless mind reading a non-psycaster can hope for.

ResearchProjectDef.label: miner subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in mining and act as a digital encyclopedia on that particular subject. The subpersona can quickly and accurately analyze different types of stone, soil and ores to plan out the most efficient way to unearth them.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mini-turret gravdrone module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible spine replacement. The module consists of a drone-like turret platform suspended mid-air, powered entirely by a gravcore and a chip-like implant that keeps the floating construct anchored to its user. While no outside input of fuel or energy is necessary for it to function, it does require time to self-recharge and for that reason the user is tasked with deciding when to activate it. This specific gravdrone is equipped with a standard mini-turret, whose low weight and energy consumption allow for faster recharging and longer operational time compared to most other models.

ResearchProjectDef.label: minigun module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified minigun that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: monofang module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a high-tech combat-oriented device that can be installed into a jaw or any compatible artificial jaw replacement. The module comes with a set of razor-sharp plasteel teeth and compact hydraulics that allow the user to bite with incredible force.
It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

ResearchProjectDef.label: monosaw module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. This particular model’s retractable parts allow the whole limb to become a deadly chainsaw-like weapon.
It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

ResearchProjectDef.label: monoslash horn module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto the forehead. Its modular design allows it to instead enhance the host's horn or horns if they already possess any. The module comes with a pair of sharp plasteel horn-shaped protrusions which can act both as an odd fashion statement and an unusual weapon.
It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.

ResearchProjectDef.label: muscle parasites immunizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat muscle parasites, granting complete immunity to their infections. It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nuclear jump pack module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module comes with a modified jump pack. It is compact enough to fully retract into the body and can be carried around with ease. Unlike a normal jump pack, it uses uranium as fuel instead of chemfuel, allowing it to store more charges. Frequent cooldown periods between jumps are necessary in order to properly shield the user from radiation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nuclear module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. The module is equipped with a micro-nuclear reactor and chemical synthetic system, significantly reducing the required food intake. However, there is little room to shield the reactor, so the radiation increases the risk of cancer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital bombardment module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for orbital bombardment targeters. The core functions of the targeter remain the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital mech cluster module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for orbital mech cluster targeters. The core functions of the targeter remain the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital power beam module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm or leg replacement. The module includes a compact storage and deployment apparatus for orbital power beam targeters. The core functions of the targeter remain the same and it has to be replaced after each use as a result. Due to its small size and low weight, the wielder can carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: overdose immunizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module uses specialized mechanites and advanced filters in order to detect, neutralize and swiftly eject excess chemicals from the body. It can immediately prevent the symptoms of a drug overdose, but cannot cure the effects of long-term substance consumption.

ResearchProjectDef.label: plague immunizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat the plague, granting complete immunity to it. ResearchProjectDef.label: psychite synthesizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a liver or any compatible artificial liver replacement. The module is capable of synthesizing small doses of substances similar in composition to well-known psychite products and releasing them into the body. It’s able to suppress psychite cravings, but properly curing an addiction is not possible with an implant such as this one.

ResearchProjectDef.label: psywielder subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in controlling their psychic powers and act as a digital encyclopedia on the subject of psycasting. The subpersona can utilize tiny fragments of eltex that have been weaved into its circuity, allowing for faster dissipation of neural heat and quicker buildup of psyfocus during meditation.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pump shotgun module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial arm replacement. The module includes a modified pump shotgun that can be fully retracted outside of combat, allowing the wielder to carry it around comfortably with no interference during daily tasks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pyroprojector module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module is capable of producing immense amounts of heat and trapping it in a bubble-like barrier it projects around its host, cooking and igniting everything within its range. While the user is safe from being directly affected by the implant when it's active, it will scorch both enemies and allies that do not possess sufficient protection from heat and fire.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pyroweave module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial limb or spine replacement. This particular model, upon detecting an attack on the user, sends out a directional burst of highly combustible micro-gas toward the attacker through the module's vent-like openings. Due to its limited effective range it is most potent in close-quarters combat, especially against assailants within melee range.

ResearchProjectDef.label: radprojector module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module is capable of producing immense amounts of harmful radiation and trapping it in a bubble-like barrier it projects around its host, poisoning everyone within its range. While the user is safe from being directly affected by the implant when it's active, it will hurt both enemies and allies that do not possess sufficient protection.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ranger lens combat module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into an eye or any compatible artificial eye replacement. The module is able to quickly analyze the user's surroundings and forward the data in a form of a simple interface. Its aim assist, projectile trajectory prediction and advanced zoom features make it especially useful for those that specialize in ranged combat.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ranger subpersona
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture an advanced brain implant designed to assist the user in ranged combat. The subpersona can quickly and accurately predict a projectile's trajectory even in harsh weather conditions.
A brain implant of such complexity requires time to synchronize with and adapt to its host in order to avoid excessive strain on the central nervous system, its effectiveness will slowly increase during this process. It's capable of syncing with other enhancements made to assist in similar tasks, greatly increasing efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: reprocessor module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. The module is equipped with a chemical processing system that breaks down nutrients the body could normally never use, leading to increased efficiency.

ResearchProjectDef.label: resurrector module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a heart or any compatible artificial heart replacement. The module is capable of reviving its host. The resurrection process begins shortly after death and might take a few hours or up to a few days depending on the state of the body, damage and decay caused by diseases or toxins slows down the process significantly, but causes no further complications. It needs to be loaded with a resurrector mech serum in order to work, a single serum can supply the implant with enough mechanites to perform two resurrections.

ResearchProjectDef.label: revenant vertebrae module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an implant module for compatible artificial spine replacement. The module is functionally almost identical to the revenant vertebrae implant, the only difference being the option of installing the module alongside other spine replacements and enhancements.

It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.

ResearchProjectDef.label: silence module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a jaw or any compatible jaw replacement. The module prevents the user from speaking. Made with the intention of being a part of an experimental form of therapy, it has later found more use on various prison planets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sleeping sickness immunizer module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto a kidney or any compatible artificial kidney replacement. The module utilizes specialized mechanites and advanced filtration systems specifically engineered to detect and combat sleeping sickness along with neutralizing the parasite causing the condition, granting complete immunity to it. It is largely ineffective against other diseases and infections.

Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.

The module produces and mixes specialized chemicals that can be sent through the airways and launched out of the mouth or nose. The resulting chemical reaction creates a wave of smoke. While the substances by themselves pose no risk for the host, the module provides no protection against the gas produced by combining them. Syncing with other modules of the same kind allows it to work with greater efficiency.
